Estima: paid and conditional funding

The adopted A266 grant was 125,000 USDC. The earlier 150,000-USDC request was rejected; it is not an additional budget.

45,000 USDCKickoff · paid 3 October 2026
45,000 USDCMainnet launch · conditional, unpaid
35,000 USDCAnalytics & TLA integration · conditional, unpaid

The 45,000-USDC kickoff is already in received funding. The remaining 80,000 USDC was conditional and unclaimed in the saved record; no fixed deadline was captured. Unpaid does not establish overdue.

A separate proposed 10–20% operator share was discussed. Its adoption and dollar value are not established. Further prediction-market and maturity-market projects were discussed without a separately established funding amount.

The 8,640-USDC stewardship installment paid on 17 October 2026 is included above. No unpaid balance remains for that action.

Amounts kept outside the total

Some additional awards, receipts and reference comparisons cannot be added to this subtotal because settlement, valuation or overlap remains unresolved.

  • Hydro Votion: $50,000 reported paid by the funder; the initial $25,000 is part of it. Settlement and overlap need reconciliation.
  • Superbolt: $80,000 of an original $125,000 award reported paid; $45,000 cancelled. Company funding, not a personal $80,000 receipt.
  • Migaloo: 5,000,000 WHALE reportedly awarded; original approval, transfers and realized vesting are unverified.
  • TLA incentive-creation fees: 228 payments totaling 2,280 LUNA, historically valued at $159.95; excluded pending overlap reconciliation.
  • Unpriced receipts: 576 product-fee and 10 incentive/rebase events. Missing prices do not mean zero value.
  • OTC reference comparison: $80,847.41 market-reference difference on 65 USDC-funded trades, not realized profit. Sale prices, fees and financing costs are missing.

How to read the numbers

USD values use preserved historical market references, generally the preceding completed hour, or documented redemption references. They estimate value when received, not sale proceeds. USDC uses market prices rather than an assumed $1.

Totals use unrounded values, so rounded rows can differ by a cent. A transaction can contain several receipt events. Native grant transfers may have a block reference instead of a transaction hash.

Fee coverage varies by product and account. The ERIS fee row excludes later collector distributions and reserve withdrawals. Some collectors’ ultimate beneficiaries remain unresolved; an ERIS association does not establish personal retention.

The main receipt register runs through 11 October 2026, with a targeted stewardship update on 17 October. See each row for its own coverage.
